params:
  sample: "HCC1395"
  annotated: "results/vep/HCC1395_PASS_annotated.txt"
  filtered: "results/vep/HCC1395_PASS_filtered.txt"

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
theme_set(theme_bw())

# Read VEP output (tab or default format). Handles an "Extra" key=value column if present.
read_vep <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path)
  lines <- lines[!startsWith(lines, "##")]
  lines[1] <- sub("^#", "", lines[1])
  df <- fread(text = paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), sep = "\t", quote = "",
              na.strings = "-", colClasses = "character")

  if ("Extra" %in% names(df)) {
    extra <- df[, .(row = .I, kv = Extra)][!is.na(kv)]
    extra <- extra[, .(kv = unlist(strsplit(kv, ";", fixed = TRUE))), by = row]
    extra[, `:=`(key = sub("=.*", "", kv), value = sub("^[^=]*=", "", kv))]
    wide <- dcast(extra, row ~ key, value.var = "value")
    df <- cbind(df[, !"Extra"], wide[match(seq_len(nrow(df)), wide$row), !"row"])
  }

  for (col in c("SIFT", "PolyPhen", "ClinVar_CLNSIG", "gnomADe_AF", "gnomADg_AF",
                "VARIANT_CLASS", "SYMBOL", "BIOTYPE", "IMPACT", "Consequence")) {
    if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- NA_character_
  }

  as_tibble(df) %>%
    mutate(
      CHROM            = factor(sub("^chr", "", sub(":.*", "", Location)),
                                levels = c(1:22, "X", "Y", "MT")),
      Consequence_main = sub(",.*", "", Consequence),
      SIFT_class       = sub("\\(.*", "", SIFT),
      SIFT_score       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub(".*\\((.*)\\)", "\\1", SIFT))),
      PolyPhen_class   = sub("\\(.*", "", PolyPhen),
      PolyPhen_score   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub(".*\\((.*)\\)", "\\1", PolyPhen))),
      gnomADe_AF       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gnomADe_AF)),
      gnomADg_AF       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gnomADg_AF)),
      IMPACT           = factor(IMPACT, levels = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", "MODIFIER"))
    )
}

all_v  <- read_vep(params$annotated)
filt_v <- read_vep(params$filtered)
```

## Overview

| | Variants |
|---|---|
| PASS variants (annotated) | `r format(n_distinct(all_v$Uploaded_variation), big.mark = "'")` |
| After filtering | `r format(n_distinct(filt_v$Uploaded_variation), big.mark = "'")` |
| Genes after filtering | `r n_distinct(na.omit(filt_v$SYMBOL))` |

## All PASS variants

### Variant classes

```{r}
all_v %>% count(VARIANT_CLASS) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(VARIANT_CLASS, -n), n)) + geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Variants")
```

### Consequences

```{r, fig.height = 6}
all_v %>% separate_rows(Consequence, sep = ",") %>% count(Consequence) %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, reorder(Consequence, n))) + geom_col() + scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Variants (log10)", y = NULL)
```

### Impact by variant class

```{r}
all_v %>% ggplot(aes(VARIANT_CLASS, fill = IMPACT)) + geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlBu") + labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction")
```

### Impact by chromosome

```{r}
all_v %>% filter(!is.na(CHROM)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(CHROM, fill = IMPACT)) + geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlBu") + labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "Variants")
```

### Impact vs population frequency (gnomAD genomes)

```{r}
all_v %>% filter(!is.na(gnomADg_AF), gnomADg_AF > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(IMPACT, gnomADg_AF)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_y_log10() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "gnomADg AF (log10)")
```

Variants without a gnomAD entry (not observed in the population): `r sum(is.na(all_v$gnomADg_AF))` of `r nrow(all_v)`.

### ClinVar interpretations

```{r}
all_v %>% filter(!is.na(ClinVar_CLNSIG)) %>%
  mutate(ClinVar_CLNSIG = fct_lump_n(ClinVar_CLNSIG, 10)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_infreq(ClinVar_CLNSIG), fill = IMPACT)) + geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdYlBu") + labs(x = "Variants", y = NULL)
```

## Filtered variants

```{r}
filt_v %>% separate_rows(Consequence, sep = ",") %>% count(Consequence) %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, reorder(Consequence, n))) + geom_col() + labs(x = "Variants", y = NULL)
```

```{r}
filt_v %>% filter(!is.na(SIFT_score)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(SIFT_score, fill = SIFT_class)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed") + labs(x = "SIFT score", y = "Variants")
```

## Known cancer genes

```{r}
cg <- fread(params$genes)
gene_col <- if ("Hugo Symbol" %in% names(cg)) "Hugo Symbol" else names(cg)[1]
cancer_genes <- unique(cg[[gene_col]])

filt_v <- filt_v %>% mutate(cancer_gene = SYMBOL %in% cancer_genes)

hits <- filt_v %>% filter(cancer_gene) %>%
  select(SYMBOL, Location, Consequence, IMPACT, Amino_acids, Protein_position,
         SIFT, PolyPhen, ClinVar_CLNSIG, gnomADg_AF) %>%
  arrange(IMPACT, SYMBOL)

knitr::kable(hits)
```

`r nrow(hits)` filtered variants fall in `r n_distinct(hits$SYMBOL)` known cancer genes.

## Ranking (helper for picking the top 3)

Simple additive score: HIGH = 3, MODERATE = 2, ClinVar (likely) pathogenic +2, SIFT deleterious +1,
PolyPhen probably damaging +1, known cancer gene +2. This is a starting point, not the answer —
the top 3 still need biological reasoning (tumour type, known hotspot, tumour suppressor vs oncogene).

```{r}
ranked <- filt_v %>%
  mutate(score =
    3 * (IMPACT %in% "HIGH") + 2 * (IMPACT %in% "MODERATE") +
    2 * coalesce(str_detect(ClinVar_CLNSIG, regex("(^|[/_&,])(likely_)?pathogenic", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
                 !str_detect(ClinVar_CLNSIG, regex("conflicting", ignore_case = TRUE)), FALSE) +
    1 * (SIFT_class %in% "deleterious") +
    1 * (PolyPhen_class %in% "probably_damaging") +
    2 * cancer_gene) %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  select(score, SYMBOL, Consequence, IMPACT, Amino_acids, Protein_position,
         SIFT, PolyPhen, ClinVar_CLNSIG, cancer_gene)

knitr::kable(head(ranked, 15))
```
